ideas.pitch: A predictive modeling dashboard using Poisson regression to forecast foot-traffic congestion, security bottlenecks, and facility maintenance incidents across Chandigarh University's large campus.
ideas.title: CampusPulse AI-Powered Incident Forecasting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages rigorous predictive modeling similar to the Apart Research AI Forecasting winner, appealing directly to judges looking for hard engineering over basic wrappers in a large-scale university hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and operations assistant for university messes that matches student dietary goals with surplus food forecasting to reduce campus food waste.
ideas.title: MessTrack AI Nutrition & Waste Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts the winning formula of the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon into a localized, highly practical real-world problem for a massive student body.

ideas.pitch: Satellite monitoring tool tailored for university campus environmental compliance, tracking green cover and waste accumulation via geospatial AI models.
ideas.title: GreenCU Satellite Industrial & Green Space Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the technical depth of the Xcelerate Hackathon runner-up by applying satellite imaging analysis to institutional sustainability.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent student support and peer-matching platform using LangGraph and RAG to dynamically route academic queries to senior student mentors.
ideas.title: CU PeerTrust AI Student Support & Tutoring Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the architecture of the GreenNovation Hackathon winner, combining localized RAG with multi-agent workflows to solve a relatable university scaling issue.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent marketplace and escrow payment system tailored for hostel room-mate expense splitting and utility bill pooling using stablecoins.
ideas.title: HostelPay Autonomous USDC Escrow Splitter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements the robust base-chain transaction workflow seen in the Synthesis Hackathon winner, demonstrating immediate utility for student-led financial coordination.
